name: Lint and Check Splice
description: Checks that a fragment is valid BPMN, an additive splice into the current session graph, and that every new activity's job type is registered. Does not check that a real job type is wired to the right inputs, outputs or headers -- review the fragment before approving it.

properties.label: Fragment
properties.description: FEEL expression yielding the BPMN fragment to check.

properties.label: Result
properties.description: Process variable the lint status is published to.

properties.label: Feedback
properties.description: Process variable the rejection reason (if any) is published to -- map this back into the drafting turn's prompt so a redraft is not as blind as the first attempt.

properties.label: Attempt
properties.description: Process variable this redraft attempt's number is published to, for bounding a redraft loop (see gw_lint in craft-graph.bpmn).
